full_prompt_en: A square oil-painted portrait brings a young woman close to the picture plane, showing her head, neck and the upper edge of a pale green garment. Her face turns slightly toward the left while her quiet green eyes meet the viewer. Thick dark brown hair forms a rounded mass around the forehead and ears, with short curls softening the outer silhouette. Across the crown sits a narrow gold circlet made of linked round, hammered-looking ornaments. A long pendant earring hangs beside her visible right cheek. Deep emerald fabric descends from behind the hair across both shoulders, translucent in places but dark enough to frame the pale face. At the neckline, a modest border of green embroidery and small decorative forms gathers the cloth. The background is an almost flat teal wall filled with faded bronze and olive floral patterning. Its worn motifs remain visible through mottled paint, yet they do not create a distinct room or deep setting. Warm cream and muted rose model the forehead, cheeks, nose and lips with smooth transitions. A soft light reaches the face from the left, leaving gentle shadows beneath the hair, along the neck and inside the green veil. Gold details catch small brighter notes without turning into sharp glitter. The paint surface is carefully finished on the skin and looser, more granular in the backdrop and cloth. Edges move from delicate blends along the cheeks to dark, clear boundaries around the curls. The figure occupies most of the square, with the decorated ground acting as a quiet halo of color and pattern. The whole image rests on the contrast between luminous flesh, dark hair, antique gold and a cool green field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画肖像把年轻女子推近画面平面，呈现头部、颈部和浅绿色衣裳的上缘。她的脸略向左转，安静的绿眼睛与观者相对。浓厚的深棕头发在额头和耳边形成圆润团块，短卷发柔化外侧剪影。头顶横着一条狭窄的金色额饰，由相连的圆形、似经锤打的饰片组成。她可见的右脸旁垂着长坠耳环。深祖母绿面纱从头发后方落至双肩，有些地方半透明，却足够浓暗来框住浅色面孔。领口处，绿色刺绣边和细小装饰形聚拢衣料。背景是一面近乎平坦的青绿色墙，铺有褪色铜棕和橄榄色的花草纹。磨旧图案透过斑驳颜料仍可辨认，却没有形成明确房间或深远场景。暖奶油色与低饱和玫瑰色以平滑过渡塑出额头、双颊、鼻子和嘴唇。柔光从左侧照到脸上，在发下、颈侧和绿色面纱内留下轻微阴影。金色细节接住较亮的小色点，却不变为尖锐闪光。皮肤上的油彩处理谨慎细密，背景和衣料则更松散、更有颗粒。边缘从脸颊的细腻晕合变到卷发周围深而清楚的界线。人物占据方形画面的主要部分，带图案的背景像一圈安静的色彩与纹饰光环。整幅图建立在发光的肤色、深发、古旧金色和冷绿底色的对照上。
style_prompt_en: The image has a refined oil-paint surface that gives softly modeled light areas a smooth finish while leaving surrounding color fields mottled and gently granular. A cool blue-green range carries the largest area, crossed by muted bronze, olive and antique gold marks. Warm cream and faint rose form the brightest, most carefully blended passages. Decorative pattern stays shallow and partly worn into the ground, adding rhythm without creating strong perspective. Dark, rounded masses establish a firm contour around the luminous center. Edges shift between subtle transitions in illuminated areas and clearer boundaries where dense dark color meets the ground. Light is diffuse and directional enough to create gentle recesses, with tiny metallic accents held in restraint. Layered translucent greens and small embroidered-looking marks add material variety. The composition is close and frontal, balancing exact local detail against a quiet ornamental field. Its visual force comes from controlled tonal modeling and the measured distribution of cool color, warm highlights and aged surface texture.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细致油画表面，柔和塑光的亮区平滑收束，周围色域则斑驳而略有颗粒。冷蓝绿占据最大面积，低饱和铜棕、橄榄色和旧金色笔痕穿行其间。暖奶油色与微弱玫瑰色组成最亮、晕合最细的部分。装饰纹样浅浅地磨入底色，增加节奏却不建立强透视。深而圆润的团块在明亮中心周围立起清楚轮廓。边缘从受光处的微妙过渡转为浓暗颜色接触背景时较明确的界线。光线漫射，但仍有足够方向性来塑出轻微凹影，极小的金属色强调保持克制。层叠的半透明绿色与细小近似刺绣的笔痕带来材质变化。构图紧凑而正面，以准确的局部细节平衡安静的装饰色域。其视觉力量来自受控的明暗塑形，以及冷色、暖亮点和磨旧表面肌理的有度分布。
theme_en: A young woman with dark curled hair, a gold circlet and a deep green veil against a patterned teal ground
theme_zh: 一位黑色卷发、佩金色额饰并披深绿面纱的年轻女子立于花纹青绿背景前
name: Eduard Veith
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
